stem:
Priya watches four different moving objects near her home in Jaipur.
Which object is showing linear motion, where the path of the object is a straight line?

options.text: A ceiling fan blade spinning round and round
A ball rolling straight down a sloping ramp
The tip of the minute hand of a wall clock
A swing moving back and forth in a park

teacher.key_rationale: Linear motion means motion along a straight-line path. Only the ball rolling straight down a ramp moves in a straight line; the fan blade and clock hand trace circles, and the swing follows a curved (to-and-fro) path. Key recalculated for the retargeted item.
